thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Incident detected: elevated 5xx rate and p95 latency in eu-central-1 affecting Hosted API and several Dedicated pools. Alert ID INC-6790001. Trigger: edge-proxy health checks.
oncall_jamal: I'm on it — paging SRE and infra.
sre_amy: joining. seeing a sharp 5xx spike originating from our regional control-plane calls to upstream regional APIs. Correlates with increased TCP retransmits to internal ELBs. Confirming scope.
infra_liam: digging in network metrics — large increase in conn retries to eu-central-1 gateways. Our metrics pipeline also shows delayed ingestion from that region. No public AWS notice yet in the console.
ops_tasha: Quick mitigations suggested: 1) start routing partial traffic out of eu-central-1, 2) reduce non-essential background jobs in-region, 3) notify CS. Can someone execute reroute?
sre_amy: Doing a canary reroute for 5% now via routing-service. Command used:
```
routingctl reroute --from eu-central-1 --to eu-west-1 --percent 5 --reason "region network/API degradation"
```
Will watch error ratios.
incident-bot: Reroute job started (job 6790001) — monitoring for error amplification and cache warming.
oncall_jamal: Reducing background batch workers and async syncs in eu-central-1 to free capacity.
platform_nina: Starting scaledown of low-priority Dedicated pools in eu-central-1 and bringing up burst capacity in eu-west-1 for Dedicated tenants. ETA ~6m.
cs_ravi: CS update: two enterprise customers reported high latency on Dedicated instances. Preparing a short status blurb — need impact numbers to include.
product_mark: Initial impact calc: ~4% of Hosted API requests and ~8% of Dedicated slots in eu-central-1 show elevated 5xx/latency. Streaming requests (long tail) most affected.
sre_amy: Note: our observability/metrics-provider is backpressured — dashboards lagging. Using raw request logs to classify errors: majority 502/504 from regional control plane proxies rather than model-serving timeouts.
infra_liam: AWS support case opened (1234567890). Also adding extra NAT/proxy capacity in eu-west-1 to ensure rerouted traffic has egress.
ops_tasha: CS, please post initial public status: "Investigating elevated errors in eu-central-1 affecting Hosted API and some Dedicated customers. Routing mitigations underway; no ETA yet." I'll attach the internal incident doc link.
cs_ravi: Posted to status.redwood.ai/incidents/6790001234 and alerted account leads for impacted customers. Added escalation steps if SLA thresholds are hit.
platform_nina: eu-west-1 burst capacity is live. Rerouted traffic error rate significantly lower on eu-west-1 so keeping routing shift at 10% and ramping if stable.
oncall_jamal: Paging rotation: @sre_amy primary, @infra_liam backup for the next 15m. Planning handoff after stabilization.
incident-bot: Incident note: if SLAs start breaching, escalate severity to P1. Current actions: maintain routing shift, CS messaging, wait for AWS response.
product_mark: I'll draft customer FAQ and FAQ lines for CS.
sre_amy: Next steps: capture KV cache warming plan for rerouted pods, monitor model-serving p95s, and if errors persist >30m prepare failover plan for critical tenants.
ops_tasha: Logged tracer sample IDs for post-incident triage: trace-679-a1b2, trace-679-c3d4.
oncall_jamal: Thanks everyone — keep updates brief here. If you find new customer impact call it out immediately. :thumbsup:
